item.text: The multiplexer currently recognizes SSH only from an `SSH` prefix. It already has a connection wrapper that can override `RemoteAddr()`, so I’ll use that path for the parsed `ClientAddr` and consume the metadata before SSH reads from the connection.

item.text: The prefix now routes to the SSH listener, and the wrapper uses `ClientAddr` for `RemoteAddr()` when the JSON provides it. The focused test passed. I’ve adjusted detection so other callers also see the prefixed connection as SSH; I’ll now run the full multiplexer package tests.

item.text:
Updated the SSH multiplexer to recognize `Teleport-Proxy` JSON headers terminated by a null byte, route those connections as SSH, and expose `ClientAddr` through `RemoteAddr()`. Standard SSH behavior remains unchanged.

Added connection tests. `go test ./lib/multiplexer -count=1` passes.
